wynnchayuan.tab.items.about: The tooltip you get when you point at gear, ingredients or tomes
wynnchayuan.tab.panel.about: Where the translation panel is drawn, and what it looks like
wynnchayuan.tab.dialogue.about: The NPC dialogue box, its choices, and the small translation boxes
wynnchayuan.tab.world.about: Nameplates, floating text, chat, and the big text in the middle
wynnchayuan.tab.data.about: Where translations come from, and whether to help collect missing ones
wynnchayuan.items.tooltip.hint: The tooltip you see when pointing at an item. A panel keeps the English; replacing it looks cleaner
wynnchayuan.items.names.hint: Show gear names translated, translated with the English in brackets (matches the wiki and trade market), or keep the English. Mythic items always stay in English. With "Name + original", ingredients and materials get the original too
wynnchayuan.items.pages.hint: Names of quests, caves, discoveries, dungeons and the like in the content book and on Wynntils screens: translated, translated with the English in brackets (so you can look them up on the wiki), or left in English
wynnchayuan.items.shiftpeek.hint: Hold Shift to swap the item name for the other one: translated names show the English, English names show the translation. No effect on “Name + original”, which already shows both Ingredients and materials are always translated, so holding Shift shows their English name
wynnchayuan.items.market.hint: Type the translated name in the trade market; the English one gets sent
wynnchayuan.market.notfound: [WynnChaYuan] No English name found for "%s", sent as typed
wynnchayuan.market.ambiguous: [WynnChaYuan] "%s" matches several items, type one of these instead: %s
wynnchayuan.market.pick.hint: ↑↓ to choose, Tab or click to fill in the English name
wynnchayuan.market.pick.more: %s more, keep typing to narrow it down
wynnchayuan.items.shot.clash: The screenshot key collides with "%s" — please rebind
wynnchayuan.panel.anchor.hint: When pinned, the panel stays put instead of following the mouse
wynnchayuan.panel.place.hint: Drag the mock boxes to choose where they sit
wynnchayuan.panel.side.hint: Auto moves it left or right depending on the space available
wynnchayuan.panel.gap.hint: How much room between the panel and the original tooltip (pixels, 0-200)
wynnchayuan.panel.colour.hint: The border of the translation panel and boxes in game. Click the swatch for a picker; the preview on the right follows as you drag
wynnchayuan.dialogue.choices.hint: Choices are a separate box and can be set separately
wynnchayuan.dialogue.hold.hint: How many seconds the box stays (0 = always shown)
wynnchayuan.dialogue.overlays.hint: The translation boxes for NPC dialogue and the quest tracker
wynnchayuan.dialogue.speaker: %s:
wynnchayuan.world.nametag.hint: Crafting stations, raid altars and "Right-Click with an Empty Hand" count too; range and angle under More
wynnchayuan.world.chat.hint: Server messages only — what other players type is never translated
wynnchayuan.world.titles.hint: The big text for entering an area, completing a quest, and so on
wynnchayuan.world.bossbar.hint: The bar at the top while fighting: mob name, health and the Weak / Dam / Def matchups
wynnchayuan.world.tracker.hint: The tracked quest, daily objectives, world events, lootrun and party lines
wynnchayuan.world.wynntils.hint: Translate the content book, the map and the rest of Wynntils' own screens, including quest and cave names
wynnchayuan.world.objectives.hint: The daily and guild objective bars under the tracker
wynnchayuan.world.helditem.hint: The item name shown above the hotbar when you switch items
wynnchayuan.world.chatcopy.hint: Keeps recent messages so you can report a translation problem
wynnchayuan.data.language.hint: Proofreading: switch only the translations, leave the game's own language alone
wynnchayuan.data.source.hint: GitHub keeps everyone on the latest translations
wynnchayuan.data.autoupdate.hint: Download new translations on startup. While off, the mod only asks whether anything is new and says so in chat — updating is your call. Switching language never downloads
wynnchayuan.chat.translations.button.hov: Fetch the latest translations from GitHub; they take effect right away
wynnchayuan.chat.translations.where: Or settings (/wcy) -> Data -> Update translations, where you can also turn on auto-update
wynnchayuan.data.reload.github: Fetches the latest translations from GitHub. Also the button to press after a translation is merged
wynnchayuan.data.reload.local: Press this after editing the json files
wynnchayuan.data.version.hint: Whether the translations on this computer are the latest ones on GitHub. Click to check again
wynnchayuan.data.version.local.hint: The source is set to local files, so there is no “latest” to compare against
wynnchayuan.data.version.behind.hint: Yours is %s, GitHub has %s — press Update translations above
wynnchayuan.data.version.unknown.hint: Could not reach GitHub, so this may not be the latest (yours: %s)
wynnchayuan.data.collect.hint: Records the lines it could not translate into captured.json
wynnchayuan.data.collectgui.hint: Guild menus, the content book and other GUIs (off by default)
wynnchayuan.data.debug.hint: Only needed when reporting a problem; takes effect after a restart
wynnchayuan.data.debug.on: ✔ Debug dumps on — writing starts after a restart
wynnchayuan.data.debug.off: ✔ Debug dumps off — takes effect after a restart
wynnchayuan.data.export.hint: Saves a filtered copy of captured.json and opens its folder. Nothing is sent anywhere
wynnchayuan.data.export.done: ✔ Exported %s lines — look through the file before you send it
wynnchayuan.data.export.empty: ✔ Nothing to export yet — the folder is open anyway
wynnchayuan.data.submit.hint: Opens the GitHub issue form; drag the exported file into it
wynnchayuan.footer.hint: Hover a setting for an explanation · %s translations loaded
wynnchayuan.status.folder_created: Created the translation folder; put the json files in it and press reload
wynnchayuan.status.folder_failed: Could not create the translation folder: %s
wynnchayuan.status.no_dst: Read %s files, but none has a filled-in dst
wynnchayuan.status.sync_cache_failed: Could not create the cache folder: %s
wynnchayuan.status.sync_partial: Synced %s files, %s failed (the old cache is used for those)
wynnchayuan.pos.title: Arrange the boxes
wynnchayuan.pos.hint: Drag a box to move it, its corner to resize it. All shown at once so you can see what overlaps
wynnchayuan.pos.dragging: %s: hold and drag it where you want
wynnchayuan.pos.grip: %s: drag the corner to resize it
wynnchayuan.pos.idle: Drag any box to move it, or its bottom-right corner to resize it
wynnchayuan.pos.demo.line: Let's hope no more grooks waltz in here.
wynnchayuan.nametag.title: Nameplate settings
wynnchayuan.nametag.range: Range: how many blocks away a nameplate still counts (2-64)
wynnchayuan.nametag.angle: Angle: how far off the crosshair still counts as looking (1-45°)
wynnchayuan.nametag.about1: How nameplates show, and what counts as "you are looking at it"
wynnchayuan.nametag.about2: Narrow the angle in crowded towns; widen it out in the field
wynnchayuan.nametag.desc.off: NPC nameplates, crafting stations and the "Right-Click" prompts stay as they are
wynnchayuan.nametag.desc.lookat: The original stays; a small box appears by the crosshair while you look
wynnchayuan.nametag.desc.replace: Replaced in place, including the big text in the middle; the original is gone
wynnchayuan.credits.title: About %s
wynnchayuan.credits.note1: People on this list get a leaf before their name - only players with this mod can see it
wynnchayuan.credits.note2: This mod depends on Wynntils; item and ability data come from its public CDN
wynnchayuan.notes.title: Changelog
wynnchayuan.notes.none: This version did not ship a changelog.
wynnchayuan.shot.title: Panel screenshot
wynnchayuan.shot.nocopy: This system cannot copy images — use "Save to a file"
wynnchayuan.shot.nothing: Nothing translated on screen — hover an item, or wait for a dialogue line
wynnchayuan.shot.panel_failed: Could not open the panel (%s), saving the file directly
wynnchayuan.chatcopy.title: Copy chat
wynnchayuan.chatcopy.disabled: "Copy chat" is off — turn it on in the settings (/wcy)
wynnchayuan.chatcopy.hint: Click a line to copy　·　scroll　·　what you get follows the "Chat messages" setting
wynnchayuan.chat.update.link: ▸ Click here to get it from GitHub
wynnchayuan.data.fallback.hint: What to show where this language has nothing yet
wynnchayuan.data.ui.hint: The language of these settings screens. Separate from the translations, so a language can be tested before its corpus exists
wynnchayuan.notice.title: Before you play
wynnchayuan.notice.line1: Translations are here to make the game easier to enjoy.
wynnchayuan.notice.line2: When talking with other players in game, please use the original English terms,
wynnchayuan.notice.line3: or players may not understand each other.
wynnchayuan.notice.en1: Translations are here to make the game easier to enjoy.
wynnchayuan.notice.en2: When talking with other players in game, please use the original English terms,
wynnchayuan.notice.en3: or players may not understand each other.
wynnchayuan.panel.theme.hint: The accent of this settings screen: titles, selected items and switches. Separate from the panel border, so changing one never changes the other
wynnchayuan.preview.title: Live preview
wynnchayuan.items.shot.unbound: Capture the translation panel. No key is bound yet — bind one under WynnChaYuan in the vanilla controls
wynnchayuan.items.shot.bound: Capture the translation panel. Currently bound to %s; change it under WynnChaYuan in the vanilla controls
wynnchayuan.preview.panel.off: Item translation is not set to “separate panel”, so the panel will not appear in game
wynnchayuan.chat.keys.released: [WynnChaYuan] Settings and screenshot no longer take a key by default (they were F6 / F9). Open settings from Mod Menu or with /wcy; to use a key, bind one under Controls → WynnChaYuan.
wynnchayuan.world.scoreboard.hint: The sidebar on the right: raid objectives, lootruns, party and guild war. The tracked quest follows the setting above
wynnchayuan.items.wynnventory.hint: Translate the Wynnventory price box and its screens. Hold Shift to see the original
wynnchayuan.items.wynnmod.hint: Also translate the item tooltips that WynnMod redraws (Decorate Item Tooltip). Only applies in replace mode
wynnchayuan.items.wms.hint: Type translated names in the WynnMarketSearch panel; results show the translation next to the English name
wynnchayuan.badge.role.hint: Whether the leaf before your name includes this role. At least one leaf stays on.
wynnchayuan.badge.rainbow.hint: The developer leaf slowly cycles through colours instead of using a fixed one.
wynnchayuan.tab.badge.about: The leaf before your name and the cape on your back
wynnchayuan.badge.colour.hint: The leaf colour for this role, yours to pick. Rainbow mode wins when it is on.
wynnchayuan.badge.none.label: Grey leaf
wynnchayuan.badge.none.hint: Everyone with the mod has a grey leaf. When you join Wynncraft the mod checks in with wynnchayuan.com (your account and your cape and badge settings, nothing else) so that other players with the mod can see it. Become a contributor or a sponsor to get a coloured one and pick its colour.
wynnchayuan.badge.contribute.hint: Add translations for your own language, send correct fixes, or give real help with the code. Once it is used you join the contributor list with a green leaf.
wynnchayuan.badge.sponsor.hint: A one-off 20 USD or 2 USD/month or more puts you on the sponsor list with a cyan leaf.
wynnchayuan.fun.capes.hint: Players listed with a cape wear it (animated ones too). Turn off to draw everyone as usual.
wynnchayuan.fun.owncape.hint: Use your WynnChaYuan cape instead of the Wynntils or vanilla one. When off, other players do not see it either.
wynnchayuan.fun.nocape.label: None yet
wynnchayuan.fun.nocape.hint: Put an image named self.png or self.gif in the capes folder to see it on yourself right away; press Upload when you are happy with it.
wynnchayuan.fun.folder.hint: PNG or GIF. Draw on the template: front, back and border are all on the image, and every GIF frame uses the same layout. A saved file is picked up within a few seconds.
wynnchayuan.fun.upload.hint: Send the self.png or self.gif from the capes folder so other WynnChaYuan players can see it. It must be drawn on the template (22×17, 44×34, 88×68, 176×136, 352×272, 704×544, 1056×816) and be at most 1 MB (20 MB for developers, sponsors and contributors). Anyone can upload a PNG; GIFs (up to 120 frames) are for developers, sponsors and contributors.
wynnchayuan.fun.upload.done: Cape uploaded (%s) - others will see it within a few minutes
wynnchayuan.fun.upload.nofile: Nothing to upload in the capes folder: add a self.png (listed members may use self.gif)
wynnchayuan.fun.upload.too_large: The file is too large (1 MB at most; 20 MB for developers, sponsors and contributors)
wynnchayuan.fun.upload.bad_format: This is not a PNG or GIF, or the file is damaged
wynnchayuan.fun.upload.too_many_frames: The GIF has too many frames (120 at most)
wynnchayuan.fun.upload.not_listed: Uploads are open to listed members only for now
wynnchayuan.fun.upload.slow_down: You just uploaded - try again in a moment
wynnchayuan.fun.upload.login_failed: Your account could not be verified (offline accounts cannot, or Mojang is unreachable)
wynnchayuan.fun.upload.failed: That did not work - try again later
wynnchayuan.fun.remove.hint: Take your uploaded cape off the registry.
wynnchayuan.fun.upload.gif_members_only: GIFs are for developers, sponsors and contributors; anyone can upload a PNG
wynnchayuan.fun.gallery.hint: Open the cape gallery on the WynnChaYuan website and sign you in there - once signed in you can upload a cape from the site too. Political, obscene, unlawful or racist content is not allowed and will be removed.
wynnchayuan.chat.link.done: [WynnChaYuan] Linked. Go back to the web page - it updates by itself.
wynnchayuan.chat.link.bad: [WynnChaYuan] A link code is 8 letters and digits. Get one on the account page at wynnchayuan.com.
wynnchayuan.chat.link.unknown: [WynnChaYuan] That link code does not exist or has expired (ten minutes). Get a new one on the web page.
wynnchayuan.chat.link.login: [WynnChaYuan] Your account could not be verified (offline accounts cannot, or Mojang is unreachable).
wynnchayuan.chat.link.failed: [WynnChaYuan] Linking did not work. Try again in a moment.
wynnchayuan.chat.link.usage: [WynnChaYuan] Usage: /wcy link <code>. Get the code on the account page at wynnchayuan.com.
wynnchayuan.notes.update.ready: Downloaded - applies when you close the game
wynnchayuan.chat.update.leftover: The update downloaded last time (%s) could not be applied when the game closed. The file is in config/wynnchayuan/update; put it in mods in place of the old one.
